brief: Disclosures for Entero Therapeutics (formerly First Wave BioPharma and AzurRx BioPharma). Its stopped phase 2 trials: NCT04858425 (terminated after topline data), NCT04839575 and NCT04243551 (terminated, enrollment), NCT04542434 and NCT04436458 (withdrawn). For each, find what the company told investors in 8-Ks near the stop. Quote the 8-K language exactly and say whether it gives a reason.

findings.claim: For trial NCT04858425, Entero Therapeutics (First Wave BioPharma) reported in an 8-K filing on 2022-04-29: "While the top-line efficacy measure from the RESERVOIR trial did not show any anti-viral activity, the drug was well-tolerated without", providing an efficacy and safety reason.
findings.notes: The quoted passage names the RESERVOIR trial and discusses the trial drug FW-COV.

findings.claim: For trial NCT04839575, no specific 8-K filing mentioning the trial ID near the stop was found, but the registry states it was terminated due to Covid-19 interruptions and enrollment challenges.
For trial NCT04243551, no specific 8-K filing mentioning the trial ID near the stop was found, but the registry states it was terminated due to low enrollment related to Covid.

For trial NCT04542434, Entero Therapeutics (First Wave BioPharma) did not start the study; the registry states it was withdrawn because the "Sponsor asset acquired by another pharma company who opened their own IND for this compound."
findings.notes: Registry record states it was never started and was acquired by another company.

findings.claim: For trial NCT04436458, Entero Therapeutics (First Wave BioPharma) did not start the study; the registry states it was withdrawn because the "Sponsor asset acquired by another pharma company who opened their own IND for this compound."
findings.notes: Registry record states it was never started and was acquired by another company.
